scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run build --workspace backend" "npm run build --workspace frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run start --workspace backend" "npm run start --workspace frontend"
